title: ticket template: no-fix re-check (template_version 2)
description: NO_FIX_AVAILABLE (owner, 2026-11-04): a 30-day automatic exemption (ceiling 90; a ticket-level SLA pause, never a gate exception), a vendor re-check EVERY 30 days, a review EVERY 90 days, and at 180 days the advisory "this has become something like a permanent risk acceptance; look for an alternative" -- earlier and escalated for critical and high, none for low. All configurable. A later submission saying FIX_AVAILABLE reopens it as remediation. KDEC-037.

exemption_days.description: The automatic exemption in days (default and ceiling: owner settings).

recheck_days.description: Days until the vendor re-check (default: the register's numbers.no_fix_recheck_days, else the kit default).

receipt.description: A custody receipt for the evidence (a store's object id or signature).
